translations.idiomatic: He became transferred to Remonstrator of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 時初置是官，尤清近，中書令馬周嘆曰：「恨資品妄高，不得歷此職！」

translations.literal: At the time this office was first established and was especially close and eminent; Chief Minister of the Secretariat Ma Zhou sighed: "I regret that qualification and rank are wrongly high—I cannot have held this office!"
translations.idiomatic: At that time, this office was first established and was especially close and eminent; Chief Minister of the Secretariat Ma Zhou sighed: "I regret that qualification and rank are wrongly high—I cannot have held this office!"

sentences.zh: 又與令狐德棻等撰《晉書》，大抵凡例皆播所發也。

translations.literal: He also together with Linghu Defen and others compiled the Book of Jin; in general the principles were all initiated by Bo.
translations.idiomatic: He also together with Linghu Defen and others compiled the Book of Jin, in general the principles were all initiated by Bo.

sentences.zh: 有司建言：「謀反大逆，惟父子坐死，不及兄弟，請更議。」

translations.literal: The relevant offices proposed: "For rebellion and great treason only father and son sit for death, not extending to brothers—please reconsider."
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices proposed: "For rebellion and great treason only father and son sit for death, not extending to brothers—please reconsider."

sentences.zh: 詔群臣大議，播曰：「兄弟雖孔懷之重，然比於父子則輕，故生有異室，死有別宗。

translations.literal: An edict ordered great debate among ministers; Bo said: "Brothers, though the weight of the same womb, compared with father and son are lighter—therefore in life there are separate chambers, in death separate ancestral lines.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered great debate among ministers, Bo said: "Brothers, though the weight of the same womb, compared with father and son are lighter—therefore in life there are separate chambers, in death separate ancestral lines.

sentences.zh: 今高官重爵，本蔭唯逮子孫，而不及昆季，烏得榮隔其蔭，而罪均其罰？」

translations.literal: Now high office and heavy rank—hereditary privilege extends only to sons and grandsons, not reaching brothers—how can honor be divided in privilege yet punishment be equal in guilt?"
translations.idiomatic: Now high office and heavy rank—hereditary privilege extends only to sons and grandsons, not reaching brothers—how can honor be divided in privilege yet punishment be equal in guilt?"

sentences.zh: 詔從播議。

translations.literal: The edict followed Bo's debate.
translations.idiomatic: The edict followed Bo's debate.

sentences.zh: 永徽後，仕益貴，歷諫議大夫、給事中。

translations.literal: After Yonghui his office grew ever more honored; he successively served as Remonstrator of the Left and Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: After Yonghui his office grew ever more honored, he successively served as Remonstrator of the Left and Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 始，播與許敬宗撰《高祖實錄》，興創業，盡貞觀十四年。

translations.literal: At first Bo together with Xu Jingzong compiled the Veritable Records of Emperor Gaozu, from founding the enterprise through the fourteenth year of Zhenguan.
translations.idiomatic: At first Bo together with Xu Jingzong compiled the Veritable Records of Emperor Gaozu, from founding the enterprise through the fourteenth year of Zhenguan.

sentences.zh: 至是，又撰《太宗實錄》，訖二十三年。

translations.literal: At this time he again compiled the Veritable Records of Emperor Taizong, through the twenty-third year.
translations.idiomatic: At this time he again compiled the Veritable Records of Emperor Taizong, through the twenty-third year.

sentences.zh: 坐事出為越州長史，徙安州，卒。

translations.literal: Charged with an offense he went out as Prefect of Yuezhou, was transferred to Anzhou, and died.
translations.idiomatic: After being charged with an offense, he went out as Prefect of Yuezhou, was transferred to Anzhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 房玄齡嘗稱播：「陳壽之流乎！」

translations.literal: Fang Xuanling once praised Bo: "A man of Chen Shou's kind!"
translations.idiomatic: Fang Xuanling once praised Bo: "A man of Chen Shou's kind!"

sentences.zh: 玄齡患顏師古註《漢書》文繁，令掇其要為四十篇。

translations.literal: Xuanling, troubled that Yan Shigu's annotation of the Book of Han was verbose, ordered extracting the essentials into forty chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanling. troubled that Yan Shigu's annotation of the Book of Han was verbose, ordered extracting the essentials into forty chapters.

sentences.zh: 是時《漢書》學大興，其章章者若劉伯莊、秦景通兄弟、劉訥言，皆名家。

translations.literal: At the time study of the Book of Han greatly flourished; the prominent were Liu Bozhuang, the brothers Qin Jingtong, and Liu Neyan—all renowned families.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, study of the Book of Han greatly flourished; the prominent were Liu Bozhuang, the brothers Qin Jingtong, and Liu Neyan—all renowned families.

sentences.zh: 伯莊者，彭城人，為弘文館學士，遷國子博士，與許敬宗等論撰甚多，終崇賢館學士。

translations.literal: Bozhuang was a native of Pengcheng, served as academician of the Hongwen Hall, was transferred to Erudite of the Directorate of Education, together with Xu Jingzong and others debated and compiled many works, and ended as academician of the Chongxian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhuang was a native of Pengcheng. served as academician of the Hongwen Hall, was transferred to Erudite of the Directorate of Education, together with Xu Jingzong and others debated and compiled many works, and ended as academician of the Chongxian Hall.

sentences.zh: 自所著書亦百餘篇。

translations.literal: His own compositions also numbered more than one hundred chapters.
translations.idiomatic: He himself wrote more than more than one hundred chapters.

sentences.zh: 子之宏，世其學。

translations.literal: His son Zhihong inherited the learning.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhihong carried on the tradition.

sentences.zh: 武後時，以著作郎兼修國史，終相王府司馬。

translations.literal: In Empress Wu's time, as Gentleman of the Secretariat he concurrently revised the National History and ended as Administrative Assistant of the Princely Household of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Empress Wu's time. as Gentleman of the Secretariat he concurrently revised the National History and ended as Administrative Assistant of the Princely Household of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 睿宗立，贈秘書監。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ruizong took the throne he was posthumously appointed Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ruizong took the throne he became posthumously appointed Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 景通者，晉陵人。

translations.literal: Jingtong was a native of Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtong came from Jinling.

sentences.zh: 與弟暐俱有名，皆精《漢書》，號「大秦君」、「小秦君」。

translations.literal: Together with his younger brother Hui both were famous; both were accomplished in the Book of Han and were styled "Great Lord Qin" and "Lesser Lord Qin."
translations.idiomatic: He and his younger brother Hui both were famous; both were accomplished in the Book of Han and were styled "Great Lord Qin" and "Lesser Lord Qin."

sentences.zh: 當時治《漢書》，非其授者，以為無法雲。

translations.literal: At the time those who studied the Book of Han—if not their disciples—were considered to have no method.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, those who studied the Book of Han—if not their disciples—were considered to have no method.

sentences.zh: 景通仕至太子洗馬、兼崇賢館學士。

translations.literal: Jingtong served up to Palace Steward of the Crown Prince and concurrently academician of the Chongxian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtong served up to Palace Steward of the Crown Prince and concurrently academician of the Chongxian Hall.

sentences.zh: 暐後復踐其官及職。

translations.literal: Hui later again held his brother's office and duties.
translations.idiomatic: Hui later again held his brother's office and duties.

sentences.zh: 訥言，乾封中歷都水監主簿，以《漢書》授沛王。

translations.literal: Neyan, in the Qianfeng era successively served as Director of the Directorate of Waterways and instructed the Prince of Pei in the Book of Han.
translations.idiomatic: Neyan. in the Qianfeng era successively served as Director of the Directorate of Waterways and instructed the Prince of Pei in the Book of Han.

sentences.zh: 王為太子，擢訥言洗馬兼侍讀。

translations.literal: When the prince became crown prince he was promoted to Palace Steward Neyan and concurrently Reader-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Once the prince became heir, he was promoted to Palace Steward Neyan and concurrently Reader-in-Attendance.

sentences.zh: 嘗集俳諧十五篇，為太子歡。

translations.literal: He once compiled fifteen chapters of jest and wit to amuse the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: He once compiled fifteen chapters of jest and wit to amuse the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 太子廢，高宗見，怒，除名為民。

translations.literal: When the crown prince was deposed, Emperor Gaozong saw this and was angry; he was stripped of name and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: After the crown prince was deposed, Emperor Gaozong saw this and was angry; he was stripped of name and made a commoner.

sentences.zh: 復坐事流死振州。

translations.literal: Again charged with an offense he was exiled and died at Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Charged again with an offense, he was exiled and died at Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 羅道琮，蒲州虞鄉人。

translations.literal: Luo Daocong was a native of Yuxiang in Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Daocong came from Yuxiang in Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 慷慨尚節義。

translations.literal: Bold and generous, he valued integrity and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: A bold and generous man, he valued integrity and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 貞觀末，上書忤旨，徙嶺表。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhenguan he submitted a memorial that offended the intent and was banished to Lingbiao.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of Zhenguan he submitted a memorial that offended the intent and was banished to Lingbiao.

sentences.zh: 有同斥者死荊、襄間，臨終泣曰：「人生有死，獨委骨異壤邪？」

translations.literal: A fellow exile dying between Jing and Xiang, on the verge of death wept: "Human life has death—must I alone leave my bones in alien soil?"
translations.idiomatic: A fellow exile dying between Jing and Xiang, on the verge of death wept: "Human life has death—must I alone leave my bones in alien soil?"

sentences.zh: 道琮曰：「吾若還，終不使君獨留此。」

translations.literal: Daocong said: "If I return, in the end I will not let you alone remain here."
translations.idiomatic: Daocong said: "If I return. in the end I will not let you alone remain here."

sentences.zh: 瘞路左去。

translations.literal: He buried him by the roadside and departed.
translations.idiomatic: He buried him by the roadside and departed.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，遇赦歸，方霖潦積水，失其殯處，道琮慟諸野，波中忽若湓沸者。

translations.literal: After more than a year he met amnesty and returned; just then continuous rain and floods had accumulated; he lost the place of burial; Daocong wailed in the wilds, and in the water suddenly something seemed to boil.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later he met amnesty and returned; just then continuous rain and floods had accumulated; he lost the place of burial; Daocong wailed in the wilds, and in the water suddenly something seemed to boil.

sentences.zh: 道琮曰：「若屍在，可再沸。」

translations.literal: Daocong said: "If the corpse is there, it can boil again."
translations.idiomatic: Daocong said: "If the corpse is there. it can boil again."

sentences.zh: 祝已，水復湧，乃得屍，負之還鄉。

translations.literal: After the prayer the water surged again; he then obtained the corpse and carried it back to his native district.
translations.idiomatic: After the prayer the water surged again, he then obtained the corpse and carried it back to his native district.

sentences.zh: 尋擢明經，仕至太學博士，為時名儒。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted for the mingjing examination, served up to Erudite of the Imperial University, and was a renowned Confucian of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after he was promoted for the mingjing examination, served up to Erudite of the Imperial University, and was a renowned Confucian of the age.
